purpose: Complete-workflow resource evidence for research candidates; not a scientific promotion by itself
ordering: alternate candidate and baseline order within each workload and repetition
cache_rules: Start every measured arm in a new process tree and new output directory
Prewarm identical immutable input files outside the timed region for both methods
Include all model loading, parsing, extraction, computation and output serialization inside timing
Do not use cached observed profiles, expected profiles, residuals, scores or analysis outputs in measured execution
Run resource measurements without another research workload on this host; record remaining host activity
primary_stages: load checksum-locked aligned BAM and BAI, FASTA and index, blacklist and peak/region inputs
fit bias model from each method's prespecified training inputs; include control-data I/O and every ensemble seed required by the candidate
extract observed cuts and infer expected cuts
apply the frozen normalization and correction operator
write the same declared user-facing output products and verify their complete coverage
baseline: production DWM correction and footprint workflow from research checkout at frozen code identity
additional_control: same-operator DWM expectation/residual scoring, reported separately to distinguish correction from detector effects

timing.cpu_definition: sum of user and system CPU seconds for all measured processes including reaped descendants
timing.wall_definition: monotonic elapsed time from fresh workflow launch through final output closure
timing.memory_requirement: isolated process-tree accounting with a documented absolute simultaneous peak; do not substitute parent-only RSS, sampled peaks, cumulative child high-water marks, or subtraction of high-water marks
timing.model_size: all deployable model files and required sidecars, including every ensemble component

comparison.runtime_ratio: largest across workloads of candidate mean CPU divided by baseline mean CPU
comparison.memory_ratio: largest across workloads of candidate maximum absolute peak divided by baseline maximum absolute peak
comparison.incomplete_cases: fail closed; retain failed and interrupted attempts without selecting favorable repeats

execution_freeze_requires: exact command arrays and complete expected case matrix
SHA-256 identities of every scientific input, configuration, model source, and calculation module
runtime, native extensions, CPU affinity and measurement implementation identities
candidate and baseline produce equivalent output contracts; any unsupported production product leaves the gate incomplete
same-method numerical, site-order, strand-orientation and shape parity tests against archived or independent reference calculations
declared model-training source chromosomes and no selection using examined test labels
verified process-tree CPU and absolute peak-memory instrumentation
immutable configuration hash created before the first resource measurement
